wire.login.bedrock.access_key_id_invalid.note: Part of the Amazon Bedrock connect flow.

wire.login.bedrock.api_key_prompt.note: Part of the Amazon Bedrock connect flow.

wire.login.bedrock.cancelled.note: Part of the Amazon Bedrock connect flow.

wire.login.bedrock.checking.note: Part of the Amazon Bedrock connect flow.

wire.login.bedrock.choice_default_prompt.note: {default} is a number; trailing space significant.

wire.login.bedrock.choice_invalid.note: Part of the Amazon Bedrock connect flow.

wire.login.bedrock.context_unreadable.note: {detail} is parser output in English; keep verbatim.

wire.login.bedrock.field_hint.note: Hint under every typed Bedrock field. Esc cancels the whole setup on most fields but only returns to the Region list on the typed-Region field, so keep it generic: 'cancels' without an object.

wire.login.bedrock.kind_assume_role.note: Profile kind: assumes an IAM role.

wire.login.bedrock.kind_login.note: Profile kind created by the 'aws login' command; keep 'AWS login'.

wire.login.bedrock.kind_static.note: Profile kind: long-lived keys in ~/.aws/credentials. Short label.

wire.login.bedrock.kind_web_identity.note: Profile kind: OIDC web identity token.

wire.login.bedrock.method_access_key.note: AWS access key ID + secret access key.

wire.login.bedrock.method_access_key_des.note: 'IAM' is an AWS product term; keep it.

wire.login.bedrock.method_ambient.note: Use the AWS default credential chain of the running process.

wire.login.bedrock.method_ambient_desc.note: {sources} is a comma-separated list of technical source names such as env:AWS_PROFILE; keep verbatim. AWS_PROFILE is an environment variable and AgentCore an AWS product; keep both.

wire.login.bedrock.method_ambient_desc_n.note: AWS_PROFILE is an environment variable and AgentCore an AWS product; keep both.

wire.login.bedrock.method_api_key.note: Amazon Bedrock API key (AWS product term).

wire.login.bedrock.method_api_key_desc.note: Part of the Amazon Bedrock connect flow.

wire.login.bedrock.method_profile.note: A named profile from the user's AWS CLI configuration.

wire.login.bedrock.method_profile_desc.note: Lists the non-SSO AWS profile kinds; keep it short.

wire.login.bedrock.method_profile_none.note: Shown when no non-SSO AWS profiles exist.

wire.login.bedrock.method_sso.note: 'AWS SSO' is the product name users know for IAM Identity Center; keep 'AWS SSO'.

wire.login.bedrock.method_sso_desc.note: 'IAM Identity Center' is an AWS product term and 'aws login' a command; keep both verbatim.

wire.login.bedrock.method_sso_none.note: 'aws login' is a command; keep verbatim. Shown when the user's AWS configuration has no SSO profiles.

wire.login.bedrock.method_title.note: Title of the first single-select list in the Bedrock sign-in.

wire.login.bedrock.no_profiles.note: 'aws configure' is a command; keep verbatim.

wire.login.bedrock.no_sso_profiles.note: 'aws configure sso' is a command; keep verbatim. 'AWS SSO' is a product name; keep.

wire.login.bedrock.picker_title.note: Header of the picker card during the Amazon Bedrock sign-in (replaces "the agent needs your decision"). Imperative title, no punctuation.

wire.login.bedrock.profile_desc.note: Three facts joined by a middle dot; {kind}, {session} are other keys from this namespace, {region} an AWS Region id.

wire.login.bedrock.profile_desc_short.note: {kind} is a kind label from this namespace, {region} an AWS Region id.

wire.login.bedrock.profile_title.note: Part of the Amazon Bedrock connect flow.

wire.login.bedrock.region_default_desc.note: {source} is where the default came from: an env var name or a word from this namespace.

wire.login.bedrock.region_invalid.note: Part of the Amazon Bedrock connect flow.

wire.login.bedrock.region_other_desc.note: Part of the Amazon Bedrock connect flow.

wire.login.bedrock.region_prompt.note: us-east-1 is a Region id; keep.

wire.login.bedrock.region_source_config.note: providers.bedrock.region is a config key; keep.

wire.login.bedrock.region_source_fallbac.note: Part of the Amazon Bedrock connect flow.

wire.login.bedrock.region_source_profile.note: Part of the Amazon Bedrock connect flow.

wire.login.bedrock.region_title.note: Part of the Amazon Bedrock connect flow.

wire.login.bedrock.region_unset.note: Shown in place of a Region id when the profile names none.

wire.login.bedrock.session_expired.note: Part of the Amazon Bedrock connect flow.

wire.login.bedrock.session_missing.note: Part of the Amazon Bedrock connect flow.

wire.login.bedrock.session_refreshable.note: Access token expired but a refresh token exists.

wire.login.bedrock.session_valid.note: {expires} is an ISO-8601 UTC timestamp; keep verbatim.

wire.login.bedrock.sso_cancelled.note: Part of the Amazon Bedrock connect flow.

wire.login.bedrock.sso_deferred.note: The user chose to run the AWS sign-in command themselves; the command is shown right after this sentence on its own, so end with a colon. Not an error.

wire.login.bedrock.sso_done.note: Part of the Amazon Bedrock connect flow.

wire.login.bedrock.sso_enter_code.note: {url} is a URL, {code} a short code such as ABCD-EFGH; keep both verbatim.

wire.login.bedrock.sso_failed.note: Part of the Amazon Bedrock connect flow.

wire.login.bedrock.sso_not_applicable.note: Part of the Amazon Bedrock connect flow.

wire.login.bedrock.sso_profile_title.note: Title of the list of AWS SSO / aws login profiles.

wire.login.bedrock.sso_run.note: Part of the Amazon Bedrock connect flow.

wire.login.bedrock.sso_run_desc.note: {command} is a shell command; keep verbatim.

wire.login.bedrock.sso_self.note: Part of the Amazon Bedrock connect flow.

wire.login.bedrock.sso_started.note: Part of the Amazon Bedrock connect flow.

wire.login.bedrock.sso_timeout.note: Part of the Amazon Bedrock connect flow.

wire.login.bedrock.sso_title.note: {profile} is an AWS profile name; keep verbatim.

wire.login.bedrock.sso_waiting.note: Part of the Amazon Bedrock connect flow.
